parameters.name: gid
parameters.description: It is the identifier of the destination location.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country code where the search is being performed. Used for airport searches.

parameters.name: flow_type
parameters.description: Describes the type of product being searched for. It allows applying rules that are exclusive to certain trip types.

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.description: They check for temporary closures, day-of-week disambiguations, and that the rule is active on those dates, and it must be sent using to_date.

parameters.name: to_date
parameters.description: They check for temporary closures, day-of-week disambiguations, and that the rule is active on those dates, and it must be sent using from_date.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: It is the identifier (gid) of the trip’s origin location. It is used to find special rules that depend on the origin/destination combination.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Defines a search radius in kilometers to find airports near the destination.

parameters.name: alternative_airport
parameters.description: It’s a flag that, if true, triggers searching for an alternative destination in a different city than the one returned by the main search.

selected.description: The destination determined to be the best option.

location.description: Contains the details of the recommended place.

distance.description: The distance in kilometers from the provided destination gid to this selected destination. If the recommended destination is the same city you searched for, the distance will be 0.

enum: RESOLVED: It means there was no forced disambiguation, so the same destination that was sent is returned.
FORCED / SILENTLY_FORCED:  A forced rule was applied to change the destination.
CLOSED_AIRPORT: The main airport of the original destination is closed on the trip dates.
DAYS_AVAILABILITY: The destination has no flights on the weekdays of the specified dates.

alternatives.description: A list of airports within the distance from the destination specified by the range parameter.

get.description: Returns static information about hotels including photos, rooms, amenities, etc.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of hotel IDs (max 100).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language code.

property_type.description: should indicate the property type (hotel for accommodations)

product.description: Possible values for this ID are:

merged_from_ids.description: this structure contains a list with all the ids of the same accommodation that were merged in the past

published.description: If False, it will not be available in the booking flow.

hotel_type.description: structure that contains id and description (in desired languages) of the accommodation type

id.description: Possible values for this ID are:

location.description: structure with geo information about the hotel location

checkin.description: time available for checkin (from - to hours)

checkout.description: time available for checkout (from - to hours)

information.description: structure with a language - text pairs regarding information about the hotel

notices.description: structure with a language - text pairs regarding information about particularities about the accommodation. Example: Reception working hours, possible charges to pay/deposits needed when arriving, documentation required by the hotel, among others.

creation_date.description: datetime field that indicates the date when the hotel listing was created

last_modified_date.description: datetime field that indicates the max date when the hotel listing suffered any changes or updates

main_picture.description: structure with url and information about the main picture of the hotel

number_of_rooms.description: number of rooms the accommodation has

pictures.description: list structure with url and description for each picture

extra_details.description: structure with extra information (e.g.: phone numbers)

smoking_option.description: A room can have three possible configurations in terms of the smoking policy.

en.description: NSM: Not allowed / NDS: Unknown / SMK: Allowed

categorized_notices.description: structure with notices information grouped by in different labels
